name: Velantis Thermcore Mid Boot
description: A sleek ankle boot with a smooth, slightly structured silhouette available in charcoal, navy, and sand. A thin thermoregulation layer embedded in the lining uses body heat exchange to keep foot temperature within a comfortable range regardless of ambient conditions — warm in cold corridors, cool in summer streets. The exterior looks entirely conventional.
functionality: Passive thermoregulation membrane maintains foot temperature between 18–24°C in ambient conditions from -10°C to 40°C.
what_it_says: Quiet competence. You've spent money on something that works rather than something that looks like it works.
story_hooks: The thermoregulation layer can be reverse-engineered to mask body heat from thermal scanners — someone is doing exactly that.
A batch of Thermcore Mids shipped with a faulty membrane that traps heat instead of dissipating it — the recall hasn't gone public yet.
